topics.title: BI 771716 / Anti-C3 AB, Geographic Atrophy (GA) — Development Plan & China Update

background.text: Ph2 VERDANT (1497-0002): FPI Jan 2025, LPI Sep 2025 (achieved 4 months ahead of plan). Ph3 studies 1497-0003/0004 planned (FPI Jan 2027, LPI Oct 2028 global; China CTA Sub/1st SIV track shown separately). NDA sub. Dec 2030.
aC3 situational analysis is ongoing to prepare for GBP workshop in Feb 2026.
background.quote: aC3 situational analysis is ongoing to prepare for GBP workshop in Feb 2026.

background.text: After initial discussion with Anti-C3 CDL and GRA in Nov, GA pipeline consultation of Anti-C3 and PAFR was preferred and needs to be further aligned with global TA level.
background.quote: After initial discussion with Anti-C3 CDL and GRA in Nov, GA pipeline consultation of Anti-C3 and PAFR was preferred and need to be further aligned with global TA level.

background.text: COMPASS (1484-0020) RWE study China recruitment as of 2025-11-30: prospective group 7/70, cross-sectional group 67/120, site initiation 7/16. PI visit held 10 Nov 2025; sponsor–PI team to re-evaluate recruitment timeline by end of Dec 2025.
background.quote: Sponsor –PI and his team will re-evaluate recruitment timeline by the end of Dec 2025.

for_endorsement.text: Updated development plan and timeline for BI 771716 / Anti-C3 AB GA to be endorsed in IUEC Jan 2026.
for_endorsement.quote: Updated development plan and timeline needs to be endorsed in IUEC Jan 2026.

corrected.detail: Background F0001 quote was too brief ('LPI achieved 4m ahead of plan!') and omitted Ph3 timeline and NDA date visible in source. Expanded to include key milestones. COMPASS (1484-0020) recruitment status and follow-up actions from chunk-1d6f7c3651fe were missing entirely; added as background and todo items.

F0002 appeared in both background and for_endorsement. Kept only in for_endorsement (IUEC Jan 2026 endorsement request) and removed from background to avoid duplication; background now carries only factual context.

Original todo items lacked owner/status annotations. Added 'owner: 原文未说明' or inferred owner where stated, due dates where given, and status (pending/TBD/ongoing) for all todo items per schema requirements.

chunk-1d6f7c3651fe (COMPASS 1484-0020 China recruitment, PI visit actions) and chunk-d2fa4d47b002 (PAFR slide repeating Anti-C3/PAFR consultation note) were present in evidence but not referenced in original draft. COMPASS actions added; PAFR slide note is duplicate of chunk-2e1f8a101e0d content and not separately added.

not_applicable.detail: Topic has endorsement request, pending alignment action, and recruitment risk — not low-information.

TBD in 'Prof. Xiaodong Sun TBD' (chunk-d0869210321f) refers to PKKi advisory board, not this topic. The TBD in this topic ('rescheduled to Dec 2026 due to time feasibility (TBD)') is noted in todo with status TBD as required.
No completed actions claimed as incomplete in original draft; COMPASS re-evaluation due end-Dec 2025 is noted as status unknown at meeting date.

coverage: All six original facts (F0001–F0006) are retained with corrections. Two additional fact clusters from chunk-1d6f7c3651fe (COMPASS China recruitment status and three follow-up actions from PI visit) were missing from the draft and have been added. The PAFR slide (chunk-d2fa4d47b002) repeats the Anti-C3/PAFR consultation note already covered by chunk-2e1f8a101e0d and adds no new content for this topic. Timeline table rows (chunk-73385cd63d6a, chunk-2bcc83c479da) are pure grid headers with no additional facts.
unresolved: IUEC is referenced as the endorsing body for Jan 2026; it is unclear whether IUEC is equivalent to or distinct from PEC/CEC — original text does not clarify.

Prof. Xiaodong Sun's participation in PKKi Asia Advisory Board (chunk-d0869210321f) is listed as TBD; relationship to the GA scientific exchange meeting rescheduled to Dec 2026 is ambiguous in source.
